description: Search, look up and reconcile Dutch cultural heritage terminology (AAT, CHT, RKD, GTAA, NTA, GeoNames, Wikidata and more) via the NDE Network of Terms.
instructions: Use list_sources to choose sources, search_terms to find term URIs from text, lookup_terms for details of known URIs, reconcile to match names (with person properties) against one source, and extend_terms to fetch properties of matched URIs.
